gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Pixelify Sans holds its line weight rigidly steady and speaks loudly. Be Vietnam Pro lifts its lowercase high and keeps its curve endings far apart, a sans-serif foil that makes the heading's moderate height look compact.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-general-sans: Loud, stubborn lettering with an unvarying stroke weight. Pixelify Sans belongs up big and brief, while General Sans, the plain sans below, keeps a tall x-height and smooth bends for the longer text.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-science-gothic: Pixelify Sans is bold, expressive and unwavering in line weight. It is built to announce, while Science Gothic is approachable, with stroke ends set far apart and no swelling within any letter.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-alexandria: Loose-striding and bold, Revalia spaces its letters wide and leaves the g open below. Alexandria, tall in the body with generously open terminals, then carries a paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari reads modern and open-mouthed, with a tall middle zone to its letters. And Revalia, with its loose stride, is best kept for big, short lines, where that open-bottomed g gets room.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-gurmukhi: A wide-striding stance and an open-bottomed g set Revalia apart. Anek Gurmukhi runs beneath it with big counters in every small letter, which should keep pages of text feeling generous and unhurried.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-kannada: Revalia is bold and expressive, striding wide with letters set far apart. Anek Kannada, a sans-serif body, handles the quieter job, its x-height reaching high and its terminals stopping far from the stem, keeping text feeling contemporary.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-athiti: Revalia strides wide and bold, its open-bottomed g loose and unhurried. Athiti, a sans-serif cut like sign-shop vinyl at a single line width, feels brisk and approachable beside that slow swagger.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps its terminals on s wide-set and its ascenders and capitals oddly clipped. And paragraphs in it should read approachably, a quiet foil to Revalia's showy stride.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-blinker: Wide stride, open-bottomed g, bold and expressive swagger. Blinker, a sans-serif with lines that hold their thickness, can easily be set modestly since its lowercase fills most of the height.
